title: fix(staging): associate COCO annotations with their source images
body: ## Summary Include the matching `image_id` on every annotation produced by `convert_to_coco()`. The current export omits this required relationship, so the native COCO reader raises `KeyError: 'image_id'` while building its index and cannot retrieve training annotations by image. Reuse the existing five image identity fields and preserve their first-seen numbering and deduplication. Multiple elements from the same page share its image ID; different files, directories, pages, or dimensions retain distinct images. Source elements are unchanged. ## Validation - Added 10 regression cases: the unchanged upstream code produces 9 failures and 1 pass; the fix passes all 10. - Exercised a real `pycocotools` 2.0.11 JSON-file load, image indexing, and per-image annotation filtering, alongside repeated pages, all five identity fields, generator input, missing metadata, and empty input. - New tests plus the existing COCO export and coordinate-system module: **27 passed** on Python 3.12. The full repository suite was not run. - Lockfile-pinned Ruff 0.15.10 check/format and `git diff --check` passed. ## Checklist - [x] The PR title is a user-facing release-note entry with a conventional commit prefix. - [ ] Please apply the `bug` category label during maintainer triage. - [x] No breaking change, changelog edit, or version bump.
